what: End-of-page Next guide: hovering the logo (a link) types Next above it one letter every 45ms, and leaving erases it at the same speed. Pressing erases Next while typing the next page name from the start, and 300ms after it finishes, the text disappears over .4s and the logo blurs out by 10px. At that moment the side that listens for fx:go navigates. On phones with no pointer, Next is typed once when the logo crosses the lower ⅓ line of the screen.

options.end: Delay (ms) before fading once the name is fully typed, default 300
options.--fx-gap: Gap between the text line and the logo (CSS variable), default 50px
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Article line box — text and name sit overlapped
options.[data-fx-part=text]·[data-fx-part=name]: ”Next” text and next page name — the first text becomes the text to print
options.[data-fx-part=link]: Next page link (logo) — pressing it does not move on right away but waits for fx:go
options.fx:go: Event the element emits when fully faded — moves on via detail.href

use:
NextAbout
Logo
… el.addEventListener('fx:go', (e) => location.href = e.detail.href)
